themes.description: 13 champion buffs, 3 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: "And lo, in our wake, the ashes of our enemies burned in their zeal." Structured changes across 21 entities this patch.

champions.tldr: Base damage increased to 35 from 30.; Damage per 5 chimes increased to 14 from 12.
champions.gameplayImpact: Bard is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.
